description: Runs a pasted Ansible playbook against the node itself via `ansible-playbook --connection=local -i localhost,` (Bolt pushes this task, no separate Ansible control node). Installs Ansible first per install_method unless "skip". Rejects a playbook that does not declare both `hosts: localhost` and `connection: local` (defense-in-depth; the console API is authoritative).

playbook.description: Playbook YAML source. Delivered via stdin JSON, never argv — written to a 0600 temp file removed on task exit.

extra_vars.description: JSON object text merged into the play; values may be already-resolved secret:// refs, resolved at run time by the console. Written to its own 0600 temp file, never argv. If a play task renders a resolved value (e.g. debug), the console redacts that value from the stored run output server-side, but the value is still exposed to the play's own execution.

install_method.description: How to ensure Ansible is present before the play runs.
install_method.type: Enum[auto, package, pip, pipx, wsl, skip]
